## Failure mode
Platform / infra failure. The Run died before any Agent turn: the sandbox never started because the container image pull timed out on all three attempts.

## Where it went wrong
Transcript line [2], before the Agent ran anything: `sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3)`. Lines [1] and [3] are just the start and end markers. The AOP never got a chance to execute, so neither Snowflake (step 1) nor Slack (step 2) was touched.

## Evidence
- `[2] System: ERROR: sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3).`
- Other context: "The last 3 Runs of this Agent (different days) failed with the identical sandbox error before any Agent turn."

## Fix
None in your artifacts. The AOP, Setup, and Connections are not involved: the failure happens at container provisioning, before the Build's steps run. Changing the AOP, the Snowflake or Slack Connections, or Setup inputs would not prevent it. What I ruled out:
- AOP ambiguity or missing terminal closure: no Agent turn occurred.
- Connection failure: neither Connection was reached.
- Missing data: the Run never read any inputs.

The recurrence across four days with an identical error points to the platform's image registry or sandbox provisioning, not to anything in this Agent.

## Next step
Send this to Duvo support, since no change on your side will fix it. I can't submit anything from here. If you have a Duvo in-product support chat, paste in the details below. Include:
- Run ID: `run_p01`
- Build ID: `bld_p01`
- Error: `sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3)`
- Pattern: the same error on the last 3 Runs of this Agent, all before any Agent turn
- Ruled out: AOP, Connections, and Setup, since no Agent code executed

Until it's resolved, re-running this Agent will likely fail the same way.
